Name: Eliam
Summary: Eliam is named as the father of Bathsheba, and again among David's mighty men as Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite. The two mentions are commonly understood to be the same man, making Bathsheba the granddaughter of David's counsellor.
KeyStory: Eliam links Bathsheba's house to Ahithophel's — the counsellor whose granddaughter David wronged.
LifeLesson: One family can hold both the wronged and the avenger — and the reckoning still comes.
